steps.source: Working Title CJ4 Operator's Guide 0.12.13, section 5 TUN and TCAS CONTROL; sim file workingtitle-instruments-wt21 2.0.4, wt21/FMC/FMC.js, class TunePage

steps.text: ADF (LSK L6) takes the ADF frequency. The DME lines (HOLD) are not available.
steps.source: Working Title CJ4 Operator's Guide 0.12.13, section 5 TUN (DME1, DME2: NOT IMPLEMENTED); sim file workingtitle-instruments-wt21 2.0.4, wt21/FMC/FMC.js, class TunePage.render

cdu_msg.title: MSG
cdu_msg.source: sim file workingtitle-instruments-wt21 2.0.4, wt21/FMC/FMC.js, classes FmcMsgInfo and MessagesPage; sim file workingtitle-instruments-wt21 2.0.4, wt21/Libraries/wt21shared.js, MessageDefinitions

steps.text: When the FMS has a message, it shows on the line at the bottom of the screen: white for information and yellow for the more important ones. If several are waiting, the line reads MSG.
steps.source: sim file workingtitle-instruments-wt21 2.0.4, wt21/FMC/FMC.js, class FmcMsgInfo.getMsgText (the highest level, then weight, is shown; yellow outranks white)

steps.text: Press MSG to read them all.
steps.why: The MESSAGES page lists NEW MESSAGES and OLD MESSAGES, six per page; NEXT and PREV show more. Leaving the page marks them as old.
steps.source: sim file workingtitle-instruments-wt21 2.0.4, wt21/FMC/FMC.js, class MessagesPage

steps.text: Examples: INITIALIZE POSITION, NO FLIGHT PLAN, FPLN DISCONTINUITY, CHECK SPEED, CHECK ALT SEL, LOC WILL BE TUNED, CHECK LOC TUNING, DL FPLN LOADED, DL FPLN FAILED.
steps.why: Only the messages whose action is described elsewhere in this guide are explained: for INITIALIZE POSITION see POS INIT, for LOC WILL BE TUNED see the ILS approach.
steps.source: sim file workingtitle-instruments-wt21 2.0.4, wt21/Libraries/wt21shared.js, MessageDefinitions

cdu_dspl.title: DSPL MENU
cdu_dspl.source: sim file workingtitle-instruments-wt21 2.0.4, wt21/FMC/FMC.js, class DisplayMenu; Working Title CJ4 Operator's Guide 0.12.13, section 5 DSPL MENU

steps.text: Press DSPL MENU to open the LEFT or RIGHT DISPLAY MENU. It chooses what the MFD or PFD map shows.
steps.source: sim file workingtitle-instruments-wt21 2.0.4, wt21/FMC/FMC.js, class DisplayMenu.render

steps.text: Page 1 of the map menu: HI NAVAIDS (LSK L2), LO NAVAIDS (LSK L3), INTERS (LSK L4) and APTS (LSK R4) show or hide those symbols.
steps.source: sim file workingtitle-instruments-wt21 2.0.4, wt21/FMC/FMC.js, class DisplayMenu (map mode, page 1/2); Working Title CJ4 Operator's Guide 0.12.13, section 5 DSPL MENU (activated items are green)

steps.text: DISPLAY (LSK R5) chooses MFD or PFD, SIDE (LSK R6) chooses L or R. WINDOW (LSK L6, MFD only) chooses OFF, ON or VNAV for the FMS text window.
steps.source: sim file workingtitle-instruments-wt21 2.0.4, wt21/FMC/FMC.js, class DisplayMenu (displaySwitch, SideSwitch, fmsTextSwitch); Working Title CJ4 Operator's Guide 0.12.13, section 5 DSPL MENU (WINDOW)

steps.text: NEXT page: MISS APPR (LSK L1) shows the missed approach, NDBS (LSK L2) the NDBs and RNG: ALT SEL (LSK L3) the altitude arc.
steps.source: sim file workingtitle-instruments-wt21 2.0.4, wt21/FMC/FMC.js, class DisplayMenu (page 2/2); Working Title CJ4 Operator's Guide 0.12.13, section 5 DSPL MENU

steps.text: Items shown dim or grey are not available.
steps.source: Working Title CJ4 Operator's Guide 0.12.13, section 5 DSPL MENU

cdu_mfd.title: MFD ADV and MFD DATA
cdu_mfd.source: sim file workingtitle-instruments-wt21 2.0.4, wt21/FMC/FMC.js, classes MFDAdvPage and WT21CduDisplay (PAGE_MFDDATA); Working Title CJ4 Operator's Guide 0.12.13, section 5 MFD ADV

steps.text: Press MFD ADV to open the DISPLAY ADVANCE page. With the MFD in PLAN map mode, <PREV WPT (LSK L1), <NEXT WPT (LSK L2) and <TO WPT (LSK L3) centre the map on the previous, next or active waypoint.
steps.why: CTR WPT (LSK L4) takes a waypoint to centre the plan map on. Before you step through a waypoint the plan map follows the aircraft; afterwards it cannot be re-centred on the aircraft (guide).
steps.source: sim file workingtitle-instruments-wt21 2.0.4, wt21/FMC/FMC.js, class MFDAdvPage.onHandleSelectKey; Working Title CJ4 Operator's Guide 0.12.13, section 5 MFD ADV

steps.text: Press MFD DATA to switch the MFD between the map and the text display. In the text display, <PREV PAGE and <NEXT PAGE on MFD ADV (LSK L1 and L2) change the text page.
steps.why: The text pages are chosen on the DSPL MENU: TO+APPR REF, FPLN PROG, NAV STATUS and POS REPORT.
steps.source: sim file workingtitle-instruments-wt21 2.0.4, wt21/FMC/FMC.js, class WT21CduDisplay (PAGE_MFDDATA toggles the map / text mode) and MFDAdvPage
